question: GQ-006
method: read-only aggregate over the gateway request log; dbstat for physical size
correction: My escalation to Shaan said the log grows '~1GB/day'. Measured: 3.61 GB on 2026-08-04 alone with the day incomplete, against 0.72 GB the previous day. Growth tracks fleet activity and is accelerating, not linear — the figure I sent him understates it by roughly 4x.
vacuum_would_not_help: freelist_count is 0, so no space is reclaimable by VACUUM. The pages are live request bodies, not deleted rows. My first theory — 5.2 GB of unvacuumed free space — was wrong and I checked it before recording it.
live_counter_note: rows and file_bytes are NOT declared as derivations. Both moved while this file was being written — 2,232 -> 2,237 rows and +10 MB within a minute — because the gateway is serving traffic. A derivation over a live counter disagrees by construction, and declaring one would make the audit fail on every run for a reason that is not a defect. They are observations with a timestamp.
